notes: HXATTR as a LINKed program: the COMMAREA sibling of cruc-hx-attr-bytes, which is a terminal transaction (HX01). The det port's LINK-entry code (the DFHCOMMAREA copy-in, the COMMAREA hand-back caBack) is reached only by a LINK entry (#7955: five det-mutation survivors of cruc-hx-attr-bytes, `det_mutation.py sibling`). Scenarios are inputs of the base case entered by LINK with STARTCODE D (IBM: a task started for a distributed program link, X19). Run through the det port (`det_port.py run cruc-hx-attr-linked --work DIR`), never plain `equivalence.py run`, whose forge stub does not port the LINK body (#6166). Same source as cruc-hx-attr-bytes; LICENSE and NOTICE are the cics-crucible's own.
